sentences.japanese: 僕が君と一緒に住んだことは君の人生観に影響を与えたと思う。
sentences.english: I think my living with you has influenced your way of living.

sentences.japanese: こわれやすいガラス張りの家に住む者は石を投げてはいけない。
sentences.english: Those who live in glass houses should not throw stones.

sentences.japanese: ガラスの家に住む人は石を投げるべきではない。
sentences.english: Those who live in glass houses should not throw stones.

sentences.japanese: 私は海の近くに住んでいるのでよく海岸に行きます。
sentences.english: I live near the sea, so I often get to go to the beach.

sentences.japanese: ３年前に東京へ来て以来ここに住んでいる。
sentences.english: I came to Tokyo three years ago and have been living here ever since.
